Power Strike Lv. 1 Delivers a powerful blow that strikes the target with 30 Power added to P. Atk. Over-hit is possible.
Aura of Hate Lv. 1 Uses 4312 Power to provoke nearby enemies to attack.
Aggression Lv. 1 Provokes the target to attack with 3928 Power.
Shield Strike Lv. 1 Inflicts physical damage on multiple enemies. Power: 833. Provokes multiple enemies to attack only in PvE. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.
Challenge for Fate Lv. 1 Switches multiple enemies' target and locks it for 5 sec. Provokes multiple enemies to attack. Applies to your character: P. Def. +15% M. Def +15%.
Remedy Lv. 1 Cures minor bleeding.
Divine Strike Lv. 1 Inflicts magic damage on the undead. Power: 65. Over-hit is possible.
Sacrifice Lv. 1 Sacrifices the user's HP to restore a target's HP with 741 Power.
Drain Health Lv. 1 Inflicts dark damage on the target with 20 Power added to M. Atk. Absorbs 20% of the damage inflicted on target as HP.
Divine Blessing Lv. 1 Restores the target's HP with 236 Power.
Iron Will Lv. 1 Increases the user's M. Def. by 10%.
Majesty Lv. 1 P. Def. +7%, Evasion -2.
Ultimate Defence Lv. 1 P. Def. +1800, M. Def. by 1620, and resistance to buff canceling attacks by 80%. Reduces movement speed by 90%.
Deflect Arrow Lv. 1 Resistance to Bow attacks +8%.

Touch of Life Lv. 1 Restores 50% HP instantly Restores 20 HP every second. Resistance to buff-canceling attacks +100% (by 2 times) Resistance to debuffs attacks +30% Incoming Heal Power +30%. Can't be used for 30 sec after joining a party. Can be applied only to your character or party member. Skill only works while in a party with the caster.
Physical Mirror Lv. 1 Reflects physical debuffs with 10% probability Reflects magic debuffs with 2% probability.
Vengeance Lv. 1 P. Def. +5400 M. Def. +4050 Resistance to buff-canceling attacks +80% Speed -90%. Applies to enemy: Switches nearby enemies' target. Provokes nearby enemies to attack.

Angelic Icon Lv. 1 Speed +10 P. Def. +50% M. Def. +50% Resistance to debuffs +40% Resistance to buff-canceling attacks +40% Incoming Heal Power -80%. With Sword, Blunt/Dual Blunt: Accuracy +6 Atk. Spd. +10%. With Sword: P. Crit. Rate +33. With Blunt/Dual Blunt: P. Crit. Damage +33%.
Soul of the Phoenix Lv. 1 Revives from death with completely recovered status. Maintains buffs and debuffs. 'Noblesse Blessing' disappear, however.
Iron Shield Lv. 1 When taking 100 or more damage with a Shield equipped, 30% chance: Shield Defence Power +30%. Duration: 60 sec. Reuse time: 15 sec.

Shield of Faith Lv. 1 For party members: P. Def. +900 M. Def. +600 Redirects 30% of any received damage to the character who cast it. Can't be used for 30 sec after joining a party. Skill only works while in a party with the caster.
Anti Magic Armor Lv. 1 M. Def. +150%.
Deflect Magic Lv. 1 Magic Block Chance +100% (by 2 times).
Shield Deflect Magic Lv. 1 Transfers magical damage back to an enemy caster with 20% chance.
Combat Aura Lv. 1 For your character and party members: P. Atk. +3% Atk. Spd. +2% M. Atk. +3% Cast. Spd. +2% Incoming Heal Power +3%.
Royal Sacrifice Lv. 1 You increases P. Def. by 30% and M. Def. by 30% of your target (party member) while transferring 90% of incoming damage on yourself.

Flame Icon Lv. 1 For party members: Speed +10 Atk. Spd. +7% P. Def. +10% M. Def. +10% P. Crit. Rate with Swords, Daggers +20 P. Crit. Damage with Blunts, Fists +10% Resistance to debuffs +20% Incoming Heal Power -30%. Can't be used for 30 sec after joining a party. Skill only works while in a party with the caster. Only one of these effects can be active at a time: 'Flame Icon', 'Touch of Eva', or 'Spirit of Shillien'.
Shield Stun Lv. 1 Makes an attack with a shield, stunning the target. While the effect is active, Resistance to Stun is significantly increased.
Sanctuary Lv. 1 Decreases P. Atk. of nearby undead monsters by 23%.
Shield Slam Lv. 1 Stuns an enemy with a shield, blocking an enemy's P. Skills. Target cancel is possible.

Tribunal Lv. 1 Inflicts holy damage on an enemy with 924 Power added to P. Atk. and greatly provokes an enemy., decreases Critical Rate by 30% and resistance to every type of close range weapon by 12%. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.
Shackle Lv. 1 Provokes an enemy to attack, then immobilizes them.
Mass Shackling Lv. 1 Provokes nearby enemies to attack, then immobilizes them.
Banish Undead Lv. 1 Fills undead with fear, causing them to flee and decreases Speed by 50%. Lethal strike is possible.
Common Craft Lv. 1 Can read common recipe books.
Divine Blade Lv. 1 Holy Atk. Attribute +5%.
Divine Armor Lv. 1 Resistance to Dark Attribute +7%.
Relax Lv. 1 Increases HP Recovery Bonus by 5. While sitting, 1 MP is consumed per second.
Aegis Stance Lv. 1 Enables Shield Defence from all directions and decreases Shield Defence by 30%.
Shield Fortress Lv. 1 Increases Shield Defence by 446. Continuously consumes MP proportionately to the user's level.
Fortitude Lv. 1 Resistance to Paralyze +30% Resistance to Stun +30%. Continuously consumes MP proportionately to the user's level.
Block Buff Lv. 1 Switchable skill. Your character cannot receive external buff effects.
Weapon Mastery Lv. 1 Increases P. Atk. by 8.5% and additionally by 2.
Armor Mastery Lv. 1 P. Def. +9 and MP Recovery Bonus by 10%.
Shield Mastery Lv. 1 Increases Shield Defence by 30% and Defence Rate by 50%.
Sword/Blunt/Dualblunt Weapon Mastery Lv. 1 Increases P. Atk. by 1.5 when use sword/blunt/dualblunt weapon.
Heavy Armor Mastery Lv. 1 With Heavy Armor: P. Def. +18 Received P. Crit. Damage -15% Received M. Crit. Damage -10%
Expertise D Lv. 1 Increases expertise in using D-grade equipment.
Create Common Item Lv. 1 Creates level 1 common items.
M. Def. Lv. 1 M. Def. +22.
Focus Mind Lv. 1 Increases MP Recovery Bonus by 3.1.
Lucky Lv. 1 At lv 10 or lower, the user will not experience loss of Exp, and after-death effect upon death.
Wisdom Lv. 1 Resistance to Hold +10% Resistance to Sleep +10% Resistance to Mental attacks +10%.
Health Lv. 1 Resistance to Poison +10% Resistance to Bleeding +10%.
Final Fortress Lv. 1 P. Def. +116 when HP is below 30%.
Fighter's Will Lv. 1 With any weapon: P. Skills Power +5% P. Crit. Rate +5%. With short-range weapon: P. Atk. +5% Atk. Spd. +5%.
Archer's Will Lv. 1 With any weapon: Speed +2 Accuracy +3. Only with Bow: P. Atk. +5% Skills Range +5% Attack Range +50.
Magician's Will Lv. 1 M. Atk. +5% Cast. Spd. +5% M. Crit. Rate +5% All skills MP Consumption -5%.
Divine Inspiration Lv. 1 Increases the number of buffs an individual can receive by 1 (+1: 20 => 21).
Skill Mastery Lv. 1 Depending on user's STR, the re-use time resets or the duration doubles.
Knighthood Lv. 1 With Heavy Armor: P. Def. +25 Shield Defence Power +3%.
Patience Lv. 1 Increases Skill's Dmg. by 20% when being attacked.
Ready to Fight Lv. 1 When using the skill 'Aggression' for you and party members: P. Def. +5% M. Def. +5% Incoming Heal Power +5% Resistance to debuffs +5%. Duration: 8 sec.
Incredible Endurance Lv. 1 When attacked, 15% chance: P. Def. +5% Incoming Heal Power +5% Resistance to Fire and Dark +7%. Duration: 20 sec.
